name: shot-kitchen
prompt: Tilt-shift photograph of a handmade miniature diorama like an architect's model on a table, seen from above at a gentle three-quarter angle, shallow depth of field, tiny model people, warm sand, terracotta and sage-green palette. Close on a small community kitchen with a blue awning under a high warm midday sun, short shadows, a clear deep-blue sky. A white delivery van is parked beside it with its rear doors open, and tiny volunteers in aprons pass brown cardboard cartons hand to hand from the van to a long table under the awning, where a tiny cook ladles food onto plates for a short queue of tiny people, children among them. A thin softly glowing green painted path runs along the road up to the van. No lettering, no words or numbers on any sign, paper or screen, no logos.
postprocess: WebP q82; the PNG original stays local in src/
use: smartclearance.com's hero film (SC-111): a plate of the journey's day, and a poster for the film
